notes.title: Recent update plan and content announcement
notes.content:
You haven't heard from us in a while, have you?  It has been a very difficult and busy year for our team.

So...

Currently, we are working on a new update that will contain a large number of various new content, fixes, and improvements.  In this update, we plan to add various features from our roadmap, and you can see some of them in this little trailer focused on dropping bombs.  This update will also include some cool features not listed in the roadmap.  Which one?  Stay tuned!

Also, since we are actively working on this update, you have the opportunity to suggest any small features you would like to see in this update.  Post your suggestions in this thread:

A new version will be updated in the near future, we have added a detonator and a remote bomb, the bomb can be attached to any surface, with the detonator you can detonate your bomb from a distance.  Bombs do more damage to any building.  Traps and mines can be laid, armed and disarmed through interactive systems or the use of weapons and projectiles.
Building system improvement.  The building location has been updated to use surface normals, allowing for more accurate placement and allowing for the concealment of leaves under the building.  Wait for our good news!
